questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Pugnacious
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Pugnacious
questions.solution:
Pugnacious means having a quarrelsome or combative nature, or being eager to fight.

Belligerent is a synonym as it also describes someone who is aggressive or hostile.

Ally: A supporter or partner.

Sly: Cunning or deceitful.

Dogmatic: Being stubbornly opinionated.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined word in the given sentence: Mayra has the ability for mathematics.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined word in the given sentence:

Mayra has the ability for mathematics.
questions.solution:
"Aptitude" means a natural ability to do something, especially related to learning or skills.

"Astute" refers to being shrewd or clever.

"Altitude" is related to height.

"Attitude" refers to a way of thinking or feeling.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word: Solomon's reputation as an accountant is taintless .
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word:

Solomon's reputation as an accountant is taintless.
questions.solution: "Taintless" means without blemish or fault, making "faultless" the correct synonym.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: Evaluate
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:

Evaluate
questions.solution: "Evaluate" means to judge or determine the value of something, which is synonymous with "assess."

"Acquiesce"
questions.solution: The word "acquiesce" means to accept something reluctantly but without protest. The closest synonym is "concur."

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence: "His ambition in life is to become a happy and satisfied man."
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence:

"His ambition in life is to become a happy and satisfied man."
questions.solution: The word "ambition" refers to a strong desire or eagerness to achieve something. The synonym is "eagerness."

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word. His approach was filled with such perseverance that it was difficult to overlook his merit.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

His approach was filled with such perseverance that it was difficult to overlook his merit.
questions.solution:
Perseverance means determination and persistence, and its synonym is doggedness.

· Ignorance: Lack of knowledge, information, or awareness about something.

· Doggedness: Persistent determination to achieve something despite difficulties.

· Reluctance: Unwillingness or hesitation to do something.

· Monotonous: Lacking in variety, interest, or excitement; repetitive and dull.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word. I was completely mesmerised by the performance.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

I was completely mesmerised by the performance.
questions.solution: 'Mesmerized' means to hold someone's complete attention as if by magic; to enchant or fascinate. Therefore, 'fascinated' is the closest synonym as it means to attract or hold spellbound attention.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence. An intense wish to learn something keeps the nerves active.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

questions.solution:

· "Powerful" is the closest synonym.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word. It takes time to adapt to a new environment.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

It takes time to adapt to a new environment.
questions.solution:
• "Adapt" means "to get used to or modify oneself according to a situation."

• "Adjust" is the closest synonym.

• (1) Apply → Incorrect, as it means "put into practice."

• (3) Understand → Incorrect, as it means "comprehend."

• (4) Control → Incorrect, as it means "manage or direct."

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence: The cynical investors believed in every word the analysts said.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence:

The cynical investors believed in every word the analysts said.
questions.solution:
· Cynical means skeptical and distrustful.

· Credulous means gullible or too ready to believe, which is the opposite of cynical.

· Distrustful (Option 2) is a synonym, not an antonym.

· Persuasive (Option 3) means convincing, which does not fit.

· Credible (Option 4) means believable, but it does not contrast with "cynical" properly.

Thus, the correct answer is Credulous.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in brackets: "He said that he lacks the ___________ to stand in a queue. (patience)"
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in brackets:

"He said that he lacks the ___________ to stand in a queue. (patience)"
questions.solution:
· Patience means the ability to tolerate delays without frustration.

· Endurance means the ability to withstand difficulty, making it the best synonym.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word. Even when he was left with plenty of fortune, he lived a frugal life.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Even when he was left with plenty of fortune, he lived a frugal life.
questions.solution:
· "Frugal" means economical, careful with money.

· "Thrifty" is the closest synonym.

· "Purposeless" (Option 2) means lacking direction, unrelated.

· "Extraordinary" (Option 3) means unusual, opposite of frugal.

· "Hardworking" (Option 4) relates to effort, not frugality.

Thus, Option 1 is correct.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in brackets to fill in the blank. She __________ requested him to pay the bills. (persistently)
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.

She __________ requested him to pay the bills. (persistently)
questions.solution:
· Persistently means "repeatedly and without giving up".

· The best synonym is "continuously", as it means "without stopping".

· Other options:

o Impetuously: Without thinking.

o Obliviously: Unaware.

o Tremendously: Very greatly.

Thus, the correct answer is option 4.
